<td class="text"><div style="margin-bottom:9pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">7.&#160;Commitments and Contingencies</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Commitments</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;text-indent:18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">For information regarding investment commitments, see the Aggregator&#8217;s condensed consolidated financial statements. To the extent funded, these investments are expected to reside at the Aggregator but may be funded from BXINFRA U.S.&#8217;s available liquidity, including proceeds from the issuance of Units by BXINFRA U.S. and available borrowing capacity under the Line of Credit. For information regarding the Line of Credit, see Note 4. &#8220;Line of Credit Agreement.&#8221;</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Contingencies</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;text-indent:18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">BXINFRA U.S. may, from time to time, be party to various legal matters arising in the ordinary course of business, including claims and litigation proceedings. As of June&#160;30, 2026, BXINFRA U.S. was not subject to any material litigation nor was BXINFRA U.S. aware of any material litigation threatened against it.</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Indemnifications</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;text-indent:18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">In the normal course of business, BXINFRA U.S. enters into contracts that contain a variety of indemnification arrangements. BXINFRA U.S.&#8217;s exposure under these arrangements, if any, cannot be quantified. However, BXINFRA U.S. has not had any claims or losses pursuant to these indemnification arrangements and expects the potential for a material loss to be remote as of June&#160;30, 2026.</span></div><span></span>

<td class="text"><div style="margin-bottom:9pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">6.&#160;Commitments and Contingencies</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Commitments</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;text-indent:18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">For information regarding investment commitments, see the Aggregator&#8217;s condensed consolidated financial statements. To the extent funded, these investments are expected to reside at the Aggregator but may be funded from the Feeder&#8217;s available liquidity, including proceeds from the issuance of Units by the Feeder.</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Contingencies</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;text-indent:18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The Feeder may, from time to time, be party to various legal matters arising in the ordinary course of business, including claims and litigation proceedings. As of June&#160;30, 2026, the Feeder was not subject to any material litigation nor was the Feeder aware of any material litigation threatened against it.</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Indemnifications</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;text-indent:18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">In the normal course of business, the Feeder enters into contracts that contain a variety of indemnification arrangements. The Feeder&#8217;s exposure under these arrangements, if any, cannot be quantified. However, the Feeder has not had any claims or losses pursuant to these indemnification arrangements and expects the potential for a material loss to be remote as of June&#160;30, 2026.</span></div><span></span>

<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_CommitmentsAndContingenciesDisclosureTextBlock', window );">Commitments and Contingencies</a></td>
<td class="text"><div style="margin-bottom:9pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">9.&#160;Commitments and Contingencies</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Commitments</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;text-indent:18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The Investment Manager agreed to advance organizational and offering expenses, other than unitholder servicing fees, on BXINFRA&#8217;s behalf through the first anniversary of the Initial Closing Date (such first anniversary, the &#8220;Effective Date&#8221;). The Aggregator will reimburse the Investment Manager for all such advanced expenses ratably over the 60 months following the Effective Date. As of December&#160;31, 2025, the Investment Manager and its affiliates have incurred organizational and offering expenses on BXINFRA&#8217;s behalf in the amount of $3.6&#160;million of which $3.2&#160;million relates to Organizational Expenses and was expensed as incurred and $0.4&#160;million relates to offering costs that are capitalized as a deferred expense and amortized over 12 months. During the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, the Investment Manager advanced $0.1&#160;million and $0.5&#160;million, respectively, of additional Organizational Expenses on BXINFRA&#8217;s behalf. As of June&#160;30, 2026, the Aggregator had Organizational Cost Payable of $0.1&#160;million due to the Investment Manager and no Offering Cost Payable.</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;text-indent:18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">As of June&#160;30, 2026, the Aggregator had unfunded commitments to existing investments of $1.8&#160;billion, of which $904.3&#160;million is committed to other Blackstone funds,&#160;and had no additional conditional commitments to new investments, which excludes investment commitments of the BXINFRA Warehouse as it is not certain whether BXINFRA will ultimately acquire any such investments. Conditional commitments are held among the BXINFRA Fund Program and BXINFRA&#8217;s allocation will be determined at closing. Conditional commitments are subject to certain terms and conditions prior to closing of the relevant transactions and there can be no assurance that such transactions will close as expected or at all.</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Contingencies</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;text-indent:18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The Aggregator may, from time to time, be party to various legal matters arising in the ordinary course of business, including claims and litigation proceedings. As of June&#160;30, 2026, the Aggregator was not subject to any material litigation nor was the Aggregator aware of any material litigation threatened against it.</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Indemnifications</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;text-indent:18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">In the normal course of business, the Aggregator enters into contracts that contain a variety of indemnification arrangements. The Aggregator&#8217;s exposure under these arrangements, if any, cannot be quantified. However, the Aggregator has not had any claims or losses pursuant to these indemnification arrangements and expects the potential for a material loss to be remote as of June&#160;30, 2026.</span></div><span></span>
</td>
